summary: Imagor is a self-hosted image processing server and Go library built on top of libvips. It provides on-demand resizing, cropping, filtering, format conversion, and image composition via signed URLs and streaming pipelines designed for high-concurrency throughput.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you need a dedicated proxy service to handle dynamic image manipulation and optimization workloads efficiently before serving assets to clients.
watchOut: The repository currently has no tagged releases and lacks recent commit activity, which may introduce risks regarding long-term maintenance and bug fixes.
deployNotes: Since it runs via Docker, you will typically need to place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and configure any necessary resource limits for handling intensive image processing tasks.
